how_to_apply: Applications are submitted offline to the college office. The notice does not prescribe an application form or a mode of sending (post or by hand). It asks that the application reach the office by the deadline.
Prepare an application for the post you are applying for (Principal, Professor, Associate Professor or Assistant Professor), mentioning your pharmacy specialization.
Attach your resume and copies of your certificates.
Make sure the application reaches the office at H.No 12-5-31 & 32, Vijayapuri colony, Tarnaka, Sec'bad on or before 15 November 2026.
The office receives applications between 10.00 AM and 5.00 PM.
For enquiries, the letterhead gives the phone numbers 040-27002221 and 9248077972 and the email [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SNVPMV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application should reach the college office on or before 15 November 2026, between 10.00 AM and 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are advertised in SNVPMV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts are Principal, Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors in all specializations of Pharmacy.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for SNVPMV faculty posts?
faq.answer: Qualification and experience for all posts are as per PCI/O.U. Norms.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for SNVPMV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send an application with your resume and certificate copies so that it reaches the office at H.No 12-5-31 & 32, Vijayapuri colony, Tarnaka, Sec'bad on or before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be sent with the SNVPMV application?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a resume and certificate copies along with the application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for SNVPMV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is SNVPMV(Co-Ed.)/Notifications/2026-27/04, dated 03.09.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Which pharmacy specializations are covered in SNVPMV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertisement covers all specializations of Pharmacy.
